business_summary.text: izmo Limited is a global technology company with two platforms: Digital Intelligence (izmocars, izmostudio, FrogData) providing digital solutions to automotive customers, and izmo Microsystems focusing on advanced semiconductor packaging for defence, space, telecom and computing applications.

call_points.text: Management expects continued growth across digital businesses and semiconductor platform
Added 170 new clients in Q1FY27, with 98.5% gross revenue retention
Operating EBITDA margin expanded to 25.1% due to revenue growth and cost discipline
izmo Microsystems continues to expand participation in India's defence and strategic electronics markets
Union Cabinet approved Semicon 2.0 with ₹1,27,500 Cr outlay, focusing on advanced packaging technologies
